definitions.explanation: The second warrior government of Japan, founded by Ashikaga Takauji and based in Kyoto. It is named after the Muromachi district, where the third shogun, Ashikaga Yoshimitsu, built his residence. Oda Nobunaga ended it in 1573.

notes:
{室町|むろまち} (a district of Kyoto) + ⟦{幕府|ばくふ}→幕府：12448_bakufu⟧ (shogunate). Also called the {足利|あしかが}⟦{幕府|ばくふ}→幕府：12448_bakufu⟧ after its ruling family. Its period, the ⟦{室町時代|むろまちじだい}→室町時代：31043_muromachijidai⟧, saw the Golden and Silver Pavilions, Noh, and the tea ceremony take shape, and ended in the civil wars of the ⟦{戦国時代|せんごくじだい}→戦国時代：19200_sengokujidai⟧.
